name: GitHub
purpose: Source control, code review, CI/CD, and secrets for every client build.

tasks.title: Create the repo under the organization
steps: Private by default; name it after the client build ID
Add a README, .gitignore that excludes .env, and CODEOWNERS
tasks.doneWhen: Repo exists with CODEOWNERS and no secrets in history.

tasks.title: Protect the main branch
steps: Require a pull request with at least one approval
Require CI checks (build, lint, Playwright) to pass
tasks.doneWhen: A direct push to main is rejected.

tasks.title: Turn on security features
tasks.doneWhen: Security tab shows all features enabled.

tasks.title: Wire CI/CD with GitHub Actions
steps: Install, lint, typecheck, build, then run Playwright (NN-PLAYWRIGHT-02)
Store every tool key as an environment secret (production and staging separate)
tasks.doneWhen: A pull request runs the full pipeline and reports status.

tasks.title: Tag the release
steps: Merge through a reviewed pull request
Create a tagged release with notes
tasks.doneWhen: Release tag points at the deployed commit.

tasks.title: Monthly access and dependency review
steps: Remove collaborators no longer on the project
Merge or close open Dependabot pull requests
tasks.doneWhen: No stale collaborators and no open critical alerts.
